title: The Book of Nehemiah Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Nehemiah — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
verses.decoded: These are the words of Nehemiah, the son of Hachaliah. It happened in the month of Chisleu, in the twentieth year, while I was in the palace of Shushan,

verses.kjv: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Hanani, one of my brothers, came with some men from Judah. I asked them about the Jews who had escaped and were left from the captivity, and about Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
verses.decoded: And they said to me, The remaining people who were taken captive and are still in the province are suffering greatly and are being insulted; the wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
verses.decoded: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, mourned for several days, fasted, and prayed to the God of heaven,

verses.kjv: And said, I beseech thee, O Lord God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
verses.decoded: And said, I earnestly ask you, O LORD God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps covenant and mercy for those who love him and obey his commandments:

verses.kjv: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father’s house have sinned.
verses.decoded: Now listen carefully, and keep your eyes open so that you may hear the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you now, day and night, for the children of Israel, your servants, and I confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against you: both I and my father's family have sinned.

verses.kjv: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
verses.decoded: We have acted very wickedly against you, and have not obeyed the commandments, the laws, or the rules that you commanded your servant Moses to follow.

verses.kjv: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
verses.decoded: Please remember the command you gave your servant Moses, saying, If you disobey, I will scatter you among the nations.

verses.kjv: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
verses.decoded: But if you turn to me, and keep my commandments, and do them; even if some of you are scattered to the farthest parts of the earth, I will gather them from there, and bring them to the place I have chosen to put my name.

verses.kjv: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.
verses.decoded: Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have saved by your great power and by your strong hand.

verses.kjv: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.
verses.decoded: O Lord, I ask you, please listen carefully to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who want to respect your name. Please make your servant successful today, and show him kindness in the eyes of this man. I was the king’s cupbearer.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
verses.decoded: During the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, there was wine in front of him. I took the wine and gave it to the king. Up until that time, I had not been sad when I was with him.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
verses.decoded: Therefore the king said to me, Why does your face look sad when you are not sick? This is nothing else but sadness in your heart. Then I was very afraid,

verses.kjv: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
verses.decoded: And I said to the king, May the king live forever. Why should my face not be sad when the city, the place where my ancestors are buried, is in ruins and its gates have been burned down?

verses.kjv: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.decoded: Then the king said to me, What do you want to ask for? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

verses.kjv: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers’ sepulchres, that I may build it.
verses.decoded: And I said to the king, If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, would you send me to Judah, to the city of my ancestors' tombs, so that I may rebuild it.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.decoded: And the king said to me, (the queen was also sitting beside him,) How long will your journey be? And when will you return? The king was pleased to send me, and I told him a time.

verses.kjv: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
verses.decoded: Also I said to the king, If it pleases the king, please give me letters to the governors beyond the river, so they will allow me to pass through until I arrive in Judah;

verses.kjv: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
verses.decoded: And a letter to Asaph, the manager of the king’s forest, so that he would give me wood to make beams for the gates of the palace that belonged to the house, and for the city wall, and for the house where I will live. And the king gave me what I asked for, because of the favor my God had given me.

verses.kjv: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
verses.decoded: Then I went to the governors across the river and gave them the king’s letters. The king had sent army commanders and cavalry with me.

verses.kjv: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard about it, they were very upset that a man had come to care for the well-being of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.decoded: So I arrived in Jerusalem and stayed there for three days.

verses.kjv: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
verses.decoded: I got up during the night, I and a few men with me; I did not tell anyone what my God had put in my heart to do in Jerusalem; and I had no animal with me except the animal I was riding.

verses.kjv: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
verses.decoded: I went out at night through the valley gate, near the dragon well, and to the dung gate, and I looked at the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates had been burned with fire.

verses.kjv: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
verses.decoded: Then I went to the gate of the fountain and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal I was riding to pass through.

verses.kjv: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
verses.decoded: Then I went up at night along the stream, inspected the wall, turned back, entered through the Valley Gate, and returned.

verses.kjv: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
verses.decoded: And the leaders did not know where I went or what I was doing; I had not yet told it to the Jews, or to the priests, or to the nobles, or to the leaders, or to the others who were doing the work.

verses.kjv: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
verses.decoded: Then I said to them, You see the trouble we are in, how Jerusalem is in ruins, and its gates are burned with fire: come, and let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, so that we will no longer be a disgrace.

verses.kjv: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
verses.decoded: Then I told them about the help my God had given me, which was good; and also the words the king had spoken to me. They said, 'Let us get up and build.' So they encouraged themselves to do this good work.

verses.kjv: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
verses.decoded: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian heard it, they mocked us, looked down on us, and said, "What is this thing you are doing? Are you going to rebel against the king?"

verses.kjv: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then I answered them and said to them, The God of heaven will help us succeed; so we his servants will get up and build. But you have no share, no right, and no memory in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
verses.decoded: Then Eliashib the high priest stood up with his fellow priests, and they built the Sheep Gate; they made it holy and installed its doors; they made it holy all the way to the Tower of Meah, up to the Tower of Hananeel.

verses.kjv: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
verses.decoded: Next to him, the men of Jericho built. Next to them, Zaccur, the son of Imri, built.

verses.kjv: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.decoded: But the sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate; they also laid its beams, installed its doors, locks, and bars.

verses.kjv: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
verses.decoded: Next to them, Meremoth, the son of Urijah, the son of Koz, repaired. Next to them, Meshullam, the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel, repaired. Next to them, Zadok, the son of Baana, repaired.

verses.kjv: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
verses.decoded: Next to them, the people from Tekoa repaired the wall, but their leaders did not risk themselves in the work for their Lord.

verses.kjv: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.decoded: Also, Jehoiada, the son of Paseah, and Meshullam, the son of Besodeiah, repaired the old gate; they laid its beams, installed its doors, locks, and bars.

verses.kjv: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
verses.decoded: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men from Gibeon and Mizpah, repaired up to the governor's seat on this side of the river.

verses.kjv: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
verses.decoded: Next to him, Uzziel, the son of Harhaiah, a goldsmith, worked on the repair. Next to him, Hananiah, the son of one of the perfume makers, also worked, and they strengthened Jerusalem up to the broad wall.

verses.kjv: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Next to them, Rephaiah, the son of Hur, who was the leader of half of Jerusalem, repaired the wall.

verses.kjv: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
verses.decoded: Next to them, Jedaiah, the son of Harumaph, repaired, right across from his house. Next to him, Hattush, the son of Hashabniah, repaired.

verses.kjv: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
verses.decoded: Malchijah, the son of Harim, and Hashub, the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other section and the tower of the furnaces.

verses.kjv: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
verses.decoded: Next to him, Shallum the son of Halohesh, the leader of half of Jerusalem, repaired the wall, along with his daughters.

verses.kjv: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
verses.decoded: Hanun and the people living in Zanoah repaired the valley gate; they built it and installed its doors, locks, and bars, and they repaired a thousand cubits of the wall up to the dung gate.

verses.kjv: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.decoded: Malchiah, the son of Rechab, the leader of part of Beth-haccerem, repaired the dung gate; he built it and installed its doors, locks, and bars.

verses.kjv: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.decoded: But the gate of the fountain was repaired by Shallun, the son of Col-hozeh, the leader of part of Mizpah; he built it, covered it, and installed its doors, locks, and bars, as well as the wall of the pool of Siloah near the king’s garden, and up to the stairs that go down from the city of David.

verses.kjv: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
verses.decoded: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the leader of half of Beth-zur, repaired the wall up to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was constructed, and to the house of the mighty.

verses.kjv: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
verses.decoded: After him, the Levites repaired, Rehum the son of Bani. Next to him, Hashabiah, the leader of the half part of Keilah, repaired his section.

verses.kjv: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
verses.decoded: After him, their fellow workers repaired, Bavai the son of Henadad, the leader of the half district of Keilah.

verses.kjv: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
verses.decoded: Next to him, Ezer, the son of Jeshua, the leader of Mizpah, repaired another section opposite the entrance to the armory at the corner of the wall.

verses.kjv: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.decoded: After him, Baruch, the son of Zabbai, worked diligently to repair the other section, from the corner of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib, the high priest.

verses.kjv: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.decoded: After him, Meremoth, the son of Urijah, the son of Koz, repaired another section, from the door of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house of Eliashib.

verses.kjv: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
verses.decoded: After him, the priests, the men from the plain, repaired the wall.

verses.kjv: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
verses.decoded: After him, Benjamin and Hashub repaired the wall opposite their house. After them, Azariah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, repaired the wall near his house.

verses.kjv: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
verses.decoded: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, even to the corner.

verses.kjv: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lieth out from the king’s high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
verses.decoded: Palal, the son of Uzai, was opposite the corner of the wall and the tower that extends from the king’s palace, which was near the courtyard of the prison. After him was Pedaiah, the son of Parosh.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.
verses.decoded: Also, the Nethinims lived in Ophel, up to the area opposite the water gate on the east side, and the tower that extends outward.

verses.kjv: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
verses.decoded: After them, the people from Tekoa repaired another section, opposite the large tower that extends outward, reaching all the way to the wall of Ophel.

verses.kjv: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
verses.decoded: Starting above the Horse Gate, the priests repaired the wall, each one working opposite his own house.

verses.kjv: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
verses.decoded: After them, Zadok, the son of Immer, repaired the section opposite his house. After him, Shemaiah, the son of Shechaniah, who was the keeper of the east gate, also repaired his section.

verses.kjv: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
verses.decoded: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah repaired another section, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. After them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah repaired the area opposite his room.

verses.kjv: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith’s son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
verses.decoded: After him, Malchiah, the son of the goldsmith, repaired the area of the Nethinims and the merchants, opposite the gate Miphkad, and up to the corner.

verses.kjv: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
verses.decoded: Between the ascent of the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants repaired the wall.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
verses.decoded: But it happened that when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became angry, was very upset, and mocked the Jews.

verses.kjv: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
verses.decoded: And he spoke in front of his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, What are these weak Jews doing? Will they protect themselves? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish the work in one day? Will they bring back to life the stones from the piles of burned rubble?

verses.kjv: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
verses.decoded: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was next to him, and he said, Even the wall they are building, if a fox climbs on it, it will break down their stone wall.

verses.kjv: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
verses.decoded: Listen, O our God, because we are being insulted; make their insults come back on them, and let them become captives in the land of exile.

verses.kjv: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
verses.decoded: Do not ignore their wrongdoing, and do not erase their sin from your sight, because they have made you angry in front of the builders.

verses.kjv: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.decoded: So we built the wall, and the entire wall was joined together up to half its height because the people were determined to work.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
verses.decoded: It happened that when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the walls of Jerusalem were rebuilt and the gaps were starting to be closed, they became very angry.

verses.kjv: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
verses.decoded: They all planned together to come and fight against Jerusalem and to stop its progress.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.decoded: Still, we prayed to our God and kept a guard against them day and night because of them.

verses.kjv: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
verses.decoded: And Judah said, The strength of the workers carrying heavy loads is gone, and there is a lot of debris; so we are not able to build the wall.

verses.kjv: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.decoded: And our enemies said, They will not know or see until we come among them and kill them and stop the work.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the Jews living near them came, they said to us ten times, From every place where you return to us, they will attack you.

verses.kjv: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.decoded: So I placed people in the low places behind the wall, and on the high places, I also stationed the people according to their families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verses.decoded: I looked around, stood up, and said to the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your homes.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
verses.decoded: It happened that when our enemies heard that we knew about their plans and that God had ruined their advice, all of us returned to the wall, each person to their own work.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.decoded: From that time on, half of my servants worked on the construction, while the other half held the spears, shields, bows, and chainmail armor; and the leaders were behind all the people of Judah.

verses.kjv: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
verses.decoded: Those who were building on the wall, and those who carried heavy loads, along with those who placed them, each person worked with one hand on the task and held a weapon in the other hand.

verses.kjv: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
verses.decoded: For the builders, each one had his sword strapped to his side while they were building. And the person who blew the trumpet was beside me.

verses.kjv: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
verses.decoded: And I said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and extensive, and we are spread out along the wall, far from each other.

verses.kjv: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
verses.decoded: So wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, come there to us: our God will fight for us.

verses.kjv: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.decoded: So we worked on the task, and half of them held the spears from sunrise until the stars came out.

verses.kjv: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
verses.decoded: At the same time, I also said to the people, Let each person stay in Jerusalem with their servant so that at night they can guard us and work during the day.

verses.kjv: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.
verses.decoded: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the guards who followed me, none of us took off our clothes, except that each one took them off to wash them.

verses.kjv: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
verses.decoded: There was a loud complaint from the people and their wives against their fellow Jews.

verses.kjv: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
verses.decoded: Some people said, We, our sons, and our daughters are many; so we borrow grain for them to eat and stay alive.

verses.kjv: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
verses.decoded: Some people there said, We have borrowed money against our lands, vineyards, and houses so that we could buy grain because of the famine.

verses.kjv: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
verses.decoded: Some also said, We have borrowed money to pay the king’s tax, and we have done this by putting our lands and vineyards up as security.

verses.kjv: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
verses.decoded: But now our bodies are like the bodies of our brothers, and our children are like their children. Look, we are forcing our sons and daughters to become servants, and some of our daughters have already been forced into servitude. We do not have the ability to buy them back because other people have taken our lands and vineyards.

verses.kjv: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
verses.decoded: I became very angry when I heard their complaints and these statements.

verses.kjv: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
verses.decoded: Then I thought it over, and I rebuked the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, You are charging interest to each one of your fellow brothers. And I gathered a large assembly against them.

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.
verses.decoded: And I said to them, We have, as much as we could, bought back our fellow Jews who were sold to the foreigners; and will you now sell your own brothers? Or should they be sold to us? Then they kept silent and had nothing to say.

verses.kjv: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
verses.decoded: I also said, What you are doing is not good. Shouldn't you live in reverence of our God because of the disgrace from the nations, our enemies?

verses.kjv: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
verses.decoded: I, along with my brothers and my servants, could demand money and grain from them. Please, let us stop charging interest.

verses.kjv: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
verses.decoded: Return to them today their lands, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, and also the one percent of the money, grain, wine, and oil that you are charging them.

verses.kjv: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
verses.decoded: Then they said, We will give back to them, and we will not demand anything from them; we will do as you say. Then I called the priests and made them swear that they would do what they promised.

verses.kjv: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the Lord. And the people did according to this promise.
verses.decoded: Also I shook my robe and said, May God shake out every man from his house and from his work who does not keep this promise; may he be shaken out and emptied just like this. And all the assembly said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did as they promised.

verses.kjv: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
verses.decoded: Also, from the time I was appointed as their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year until the thirty-second year of King Artaxerxes, which is twelve years, my brothers and I have not eaten the governor's food.

verses.kjv: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
verses.decoded: But the previous governors before me were a burden to the people, taking bread and wine from them, in addition to forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people. But I did not do this because I feared God.

verses.kjv: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
verses.decoded: Yes, I also kept working on this wall, and we did not buy any land; all my servants were gathered there to do the work.

verses.kjv: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
verses.decoded: Also, there were one hundred and fifty Jews and officials at my table, in addition to those who came to us from the surrounding non-Jewish people.

verses.kjv: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
verses.decoded: What was prepared for me every day was one ox and six choice sheep; also birds were prepared for me, and once every ten days a supply of all kinds of wine; yet despite all this, I did not ask for the governor's food, because the oppression was heavy on these people.

verses.kjv: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.
verses.decoded: Remember me, my God, in a positive way, because of everything I have done for these people.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
verses.decoded: It happened that when Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had built the wall and that there was no gap left in it (although at that time I had not installed the doors on the gates),

verses.kjv: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.decoded: Sanballat and Geshem sent a message to me, saying, 'Come, let us meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono.' But they planned to harm me.

verses.kjv: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verses.decoded: And I sent messengers to them, saying, I am doing an important work, so I cannot come down. Why should the work stop if I leave it and come down to you?

verses.kjv: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.decoded: But they sent messages to me four times like this; and I answered them in the same way.

verses.kjv: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
verses.decoded: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me again in the same way for the fifth time, holding an open letter in his hand;

verses.kjv: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.
verses.decoded: It was written, It is reported among the non-Jewish people, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews plan to rebel; for this reason you are building the wall, so that you may become their king, according to these words.

verses.kjv: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
verses.decoded: And you have also appointed prophets to speak about you in Jerusalem, saying, 'There is a king in Judah,' and now this will be reported to the king based on these words. So come now, and let us plan together.

verses.kjv: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
verses.decoded: Then I sent a message to him, saying, There are no such things done as you say, but you are making them up from your own heart.

verses.kjv: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.
verses.decoded: Because they all made us afraid by saying, 'Their hands will become weak from the work, so it will not be completed.' So now, God, please strengthen my hands.

verses.kjv: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
verses.decoded: Later, I went to the house of Shemaiah, the son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabeel, who was confined; and he said, "Let us meet together in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the doors of the temple, because they will come to kill you; yes, they will come at night to kill you."

verses.kjv: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
verses.decoded: And I said, Should a man like me run away? And who is there who, being like me, would enter the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

verses.kjv: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.decoded: And I realized that God had not sent him; instead, he spoke this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him.

verses.kjv: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
verses.decoded: That is why he was hired—to make me afraid so that I would act that way and sin, giving them a reason to spread bad rumors and criticize me.

verses.kjv: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
verses.decoded: My God, remember Tobiah and Sanballat because of what they have done, and also remember the prophetess Noadiah and the other prophets who tried to make me afraid.

verses.kjv: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.
verses.decoded: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
verses.decoded: It happened that when all our enemies heard about this, and all the non-believers around us saw these things, they were very discouraged in their own minds because they realized that this work was done by our God.

verses.kjv: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
verses.decoded: Also, during those days, the leaders of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah's letters were sent back to them.

verses.kjv: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
verses.decoded: Because he was the son-in-law of Shechaniah, the son of Arah, many people in Judah had sworn loyalty to him; and his son Johanan had married the daughter of Meshullam, the son of Berechiah.

verses.kjv: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
verses.decoded: They also told me about his good deeds and repeated my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to scare me.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.decoded: After the wall was built, and I had installed the doors, and the gatekeepers, the singers, and the Levites were assigned their duties,

verses.kjv: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.decoded: I put my brother Hanani and Hananiah, the palace administrator, in charge of Jerusalem because he was a trustworthy man who respected God more than most people.

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
verses.decoded: And I said to them, Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot; and while they are standing guard, let them close the doors and lock them; and assign guards from the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each one on his watch, and each one opposite his own house.

verses.kjv: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
verses.decoded: Now the city was large and great, but there were few people living there, and the houses were not built.

verses.kjv: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
verses.decoded: And my God gave me the idea to gather the nobles, the rulers, and the people so that they could be counted by their family records. I found a record of the genealogy of those who came up first, and I saw it was written there,

verses.kjv: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.decoded: These are the people from the province who returned from captivity, those who had been taken away by Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and who came back to Jerusalem and Judah, each one to his own city.

verses.kjv: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
verses.decoded: These men came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. I say, the number of the men of the people of Israel was this:

verses.kjv: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

verses.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

verses.kjv: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Arah, six hundred fifty-two.

verses.kjv: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Pahath-moab, from the descendants of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

verses.kjv: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

verses.kjv: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Zattu, eight hundred forty-five.

verses.kjv: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

verses.kjv: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Binnui, six hundred forty-eight.

verses.kjv: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Bebai, six hundred twenty-eight.

verses.kjv: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

verses.kjv: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-seven.

verses.kjv: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Bigvai, two thousand sixty-seven.

verses.kjv: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Adin, six hundred fifty-five.

verses.kjv: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Ater, who was from Hezekiah, were ninety-eight.

verses.kjv: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Hashum, three hundred twenty-eight.

verses.kjv: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Bezai, three hundred twenty-four.

verses.kjv: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Hariph, one hundred and twelve.

verses.kjv: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Gibeon, ninety-five.

verses.kjv: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.decoded: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, one hundred eighty-eight.

verses.kjv: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.decoded: The men from Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

verses.kjv: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.decoded: The men from Beth-azmaveth, forty-two.

verses.kjv: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
verses.decoded: The men from Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth were seven hundred forty-three.

verses.kjv: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.decoded: The men from Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty-one.

verses.kjv: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
verses.decoded: The men from Michmas, one hundred and twenty-two.

verses.kjv: The men of Beth-el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
verses.decoded: The men from Bethel and Ai, one hundred twenty-three.

verses.kjv: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.decoded: The men from the other Nebo, fifty-two.

verses.kjv: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.decoded: The descendants of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

verses.kjv: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

verses.kjv: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.decoded: The people of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

verses.kjv: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Lod, Hadid, and Ono were seven hundred twenty-one.

verses.kjv: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Senaah were three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

verses.kjv: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.decoded: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah, from the family of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

verses.kjv: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Immer were one thousand fifty-two.

verses.kjv: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Pashur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

verses.kjv: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Harim were one thousand and seventeen.

verses.kjv: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
verses.decoded: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the descendants of Hodevah, seventy-four.

verses.kjv: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
verses.decoded: The singers were the descendants of Asaph, one hundred forty-eight in number.

verses.kjv: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
verses.decoded: The gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum, the descendants of Ater, the descendants of Talmon, the descendants of Akkub, the descendants of Hatita, the descendants of Shobai, one hundred thirty-eight.

verses.kjv: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.decoded: The Nethinims: the descendants of Ziha, the descendants of Hashupha, the descendants of Tabbaoth,

verses.kjv: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Keros, the descendants of Sia, the descendants of Padon,

verses.kjv: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Lebana, the descendants of Hagaba, the descendants of Shalmai,

verses.kjv: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Hanan, the descendants of Giddel, the descendants of Gahar,

verses.kjv: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Reaiah, the descendants of Rezin, the descendants of Nekoda,

verses.kjv: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Gazzam, the descendants of Uzza, the descendants of Phaseah,

verses.kjv: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Besai, the descendants of Meunim, the descendants of Nephishesim,

verses.kjv: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Bakbuk, the descendants of Hakupha, the descendants of Harhur,

verses.kjv: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Bazlith, the descendants of Mehida, the descendants of Harsha,

verses.kjv: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Barkos, the descendants of Sisera, the descendants of Tamah,

verses.kjv: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Neziah, the descendants of Hatipha.

verses.kjv: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Solomon’s servants: the descendants of Sotai, the descendants of Sophereth, the descendants of Perida,

verses.kjv: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Jaala, the descendants of Darkon, the descendants of Giddel,

verses.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Shephatiah, the descendants of Hattil, the descendants of Pochereth from Zebaim, the descendants of Amon.

verses.kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.decoded: All the Nethinims, and the descendants of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

verses.kjv: And these were they which went up also from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
verses.decoded: These people also came up from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer, but they could not prove their family lineage or their descendants to show if they were from Israel.

verses.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Delaiah, the descendants of Tobiah, the descendants of Nekoda, six hundred forty-two.

verses.kjv: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
verses.decoded: And among the priests: the descendants of Habaiah, the descendants of Koz, the descendants of Barzillai, who married one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and were named after them.

verses.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.decoded: They looked for their names in the records of those counted by family line, but their names were not found; so they were considered unclean and excluded from the priesthood.

verses.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.decoded: And the governor told them that they should not eat any of the most holy things until a priest with Urim and Thummim stood up.

verses.kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.decoded: The entire group together was forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,

verses.kjv: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.decoded: In addition to their male and female servants, who numbered seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven, they had two hundred forty-five men and women who sang.

verses.kjv: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
verses.decoded: They had seven hundred thirty-six horses and two hundred forty-five mules.

verses.kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
verses.decoded: They had 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.

verses.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.
verses.decoded: Some of the leaders of the families gave to the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury one thousand drams of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.

verses.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
verses.decoded: And some of the leaders of the families gave to the treasury for the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand two hundred pounds of silver.

verses.kjv: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.
verses.decoded: And what the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty-seven priests' garments.

verses.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
verses.decoded: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the Nethinims, and all Israel lived in their cities; and when the seventh month arrived, the Israelites were in their cities.

verses.kjv: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.
verses.decoded: All the people came together as one into the street in front of the Water Gate, and they asked Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

verses.kjv: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.decoded: Ezra the priest brought the law to the assembly of men and women, and everyone who was able to listen and understand, on the first day of the seventh month.

verses.kjv: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
verses.decoded: He read from it aloud in the open area in front of the Water Gate from morning until midday, in front of the men and women, and those who could understand; and all the people listened carefully to the book of the law.

verses.kjv: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.decoded: Ezra the scribe stood on a wooden platform that they had made for this purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Urijah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah on his right side; and on his left side stood Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchiah, Hashum, Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

verses.kjv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
verses.decoded: Ezra opened the book in front of all the people; (because he was standing above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

verses.kjv: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.decoded: Ezra praised the LORD, the great God. All the people responded, 'Amen, Amen,' raising their hands; then they bowed their heads and worshiped the LORD, face down on the ground.

verses.kjv: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
verses.decoded: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites helped the people understand the law, and the people stood in their places.

verses.kjv: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verses.decoded: They read clearly from the book of the law of God, explained the meaning, and helped them understand what was being read.

verses.kjv: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.decoded: And Nehemiah, who is the governor, and Ezra the priest, the scribe, and the Levites who taught the people, said to all the people, "This day is holy to the LORD your God; do not mourn or cry." But all the people cried when they heard the words of the law.

verses.kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.
verses.decoded: Then he said to them, Go ahead, eat the rich food, and drink the sweet drink, and send portions to those for whom nothing is prepared; because this day is holy to our Lord. Do not be sad, because the joy of the LORD is your strength.

verses.kjv: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
verses.decoded: So the Levites quieted all the people, saying, Be silent, because this day is holy; do not be upset.

verses.kjv: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
verses.decoded: All the people went on their way to eat, to drink, to share food with others, and to celebrate with great joy, because they understood the words that were explained to them.

verses.kjv: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
verses.decoded: On the second day, the leaders of all the families of the people, the priests, and the Levites gathered together with Ezra the scribe to understand the words of the law.

verses.kjv: And they found written in the law which the Lord had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
verses.decoded: And they found written in the law that the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the children of Israel should live in temporary shelters during the festival of the seventh month:

verses.kjv: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
verses.decoded: And that they should announce and declare in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go out to the hill and gather olive branches, pine branches, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches from thick trees, to build booths, as it is written.

verses.kjv: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.decoded: So the people went out and brought branches and made booths for themselves, each one on the roof of his house, in their courtyards, in the courtyards of the house of God, in the street of the Water Gate, and in the street of the Gate of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.decoded: And all the assembly of those who had returned from captivity made booths and sat under the booths, because from the time of Jeshua the son of Nun until that day, the children of Israel had not done this. And there was very great joy.

verses.kjv: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
verses.decoded: Also, every day, from the first day to the last day, he read from the book of the law of God. They celebrated the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day there was a special assembly, following the custom.

verses.kjv: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
verses.decoded: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month, the people of Israel gathered together, fasting, wearing sackcloth, and putting dust on themselves.

verses.kjv: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, stood up, and confessed their sins and the wrongdoings of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the Lord their God.
verses.decoded: They stood in their place and read from the book of the law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day; for another quarter of the day, they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the Lord their God.
verses.decoded: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, who were Levites, stood up on the stairs and shouted loudly to the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the Lord your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.decoded: Then the Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said, Stand up and praise the LORD your God forever and ever; and may your glorious name be blessed, which is higher than all blessing and praise.

verses.kjv: Thou, even thou, art Lord alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
verses.decoded: You, yes you, are the LORD alone; you made the sky, the highest heavens with all their stars, the earth and everything in it, the seas and everything in them, and you keep them all alive; and the angels in heaven worship you.

verses.kjv: Thou art the Lord the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
verses.decoded: You are the LORD God, who chose Abram, and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name Abraham;

verses.kjv: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:
verses.decoded: And you found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his descendants, and you have fulfilled your words; because you are righteous:

verses.kjv: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
verses.decoded: And you saw the suffering of our ancestors in Egypt, and you heard their cry by the Red Sea;

verses.kjv: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: And you showed signs and wonders to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all the people of his land, because you knew that they acted arrogantly against them. So you made a name for yourself, as it is to this day.

verses.kjv: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.decoded: And you divided the sea in front of them, so that they walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground; and you threw their enemies into the depths, like a stone into the powerful waters.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you led them during the day with a pillar of cloud, and at night with a pillar of fire, to give them light on the path they should follow.

verses.kjv: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
verses.decoded: You also came down on Mount Sinai, spoke with them from heaven, and gave them fair judgments, true laws, good rules, and commandments:

verses.kjv: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
verses.decoded: And you made your holy Sabbath known to them, and commanded them rules, regulations, and laws through Moses your servant:

verses.kjv: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
verses.decoded: And you gave them bread from heaven to satisfy their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them to quench their thirst, and promised them that they would enter and take possession of the land you had sworn to give them.

verses.kjv: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
verses.decoded: But they and our ancestors acted arrogantly, stubbornly refused to listen, and did not obey your commandments,

verses.kjv: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
verses.decoded: They refused to obey and did not remember the miracles you performed among them; instead, they stubbornly resisted and, in their rebellion, chose a leader to return to their slavery. But you are a God who is ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, full of great kindness, and you did not abandon them.

verses.kjv: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.decoded: Yes, when they had made themselves a molten calf and said, This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt, and had caused great offenses;

verses.kjv: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.decoded: Yet you, in your many mercies, did not abandon them in the wilderness: the pillar of cloud did not leave them during the day to guide them on the way; nor did the pillar of fire leave them at night to give them light and show them the path they should take.

verses.kjv: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.decoded: You also gave your good Spirit to teach them, and you did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water to satisfy their thirst.

verses.kjv: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.decoded: Yes, you sustained them for forty years in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes did not wear out, and their feet did not swell.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.decoded: Moreover, you gave them kingdoms and nations, and you divided them into territories; so they took possession of the land of Sihon, the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og, king of Bashan.

verses.kjv: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
verses.decoded: You caused their children to multiply like the stars of heaven, and you brought them into the land that you had promised to their ancestors, that they would enter and possess it.

verses.kjv: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.decoded: So the children went in and took possession of the land, and you defeated the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, before them, and gave them into their hands, along with their kings and the people of the land, so that they could do whatever they wanted with them.

verses.kjv: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
verses.decoded: And they captured strong cities and a fertile land, and took possession of houses full of all kinds of goods, dug wells, vineyards, olive groves, and many fruit trees; so they ate and were satisfied, became prosperous, and enjoyed your great goodness.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
verses.decoded: Nevertheless, they were disobedient and rebelled against you, and they rejected your law, and killed your prophets who warned them to turn back to you, and they caused great offenses.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
verses.decoded: Therefore you handed them over to their enemies, who troubled them; and in their time of trouble, when they cried out to you, you heard them from heaven; and because of your many mercies, you gave them saviors who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.

verses.kjv: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
verses.decoded: But after they had rest, they did evil again in your sight; so you allowed them to be in the power of their enemies, who ruled over them. Yet when they returned and cried out to you, you heard them from heaven, and many times you saved them because of your mercy.
