verses.kjv: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.decoded: And you testified against them so that you could bring them back to your law; yet they acted proudly and did not listen to your commandments, but sinned against your judgments (which if a person obeys, they will live by them); they turned their backs and stiffened their necks and refused to listen.

verses.kjv: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
verses.decoded: Yet you were patient with them for many years and warned them through your Spirit by your prophets, but they did not listen. Therefore, you handed them over to the people of the lands.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
verses.decoded: Nevertheless, because of your great mercy, you did not completely destroy them or abandon them, because you are a gracious and merciful God.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
verses.decoded: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and mercy, do not let all the trouble that has come upon us, our kings, our leaders, our priests, our prophets, our ancestors, and all your people since the time of the kings of Assyria until today seem insignificant to you.

verses.kjv: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
verses.decoded: However, you are fair in everything that has happened to us; because you have done what is right, but we have done what is wrong.

verses.kjv: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
verses.decoded: Neither have our kings, our leaders, our priests, nor our ancestors kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies, with which you testified against them.

verses.kjv: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
verses.decoded: For they did not serve you in their kingdom, and despite your great kindness that you gave them, and the large and fertile land that you gave before them, they did not turn away from their evil actions.

verses.kjv: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
verses.decoded: Look, we are servants today, and because of the land that you gave to our ancestors to eat its fruit and its good things, look, we are servants in it.

verses.kjv: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
verses.decoded: And it produces a large increase for the kings you have placed over us because of our sins; they also have control over our bodies and our cattle as they wish, and we are in great trouble.

verses.kjv: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.
verses.decoded: Because of all this, we make a firm agreement and write it down; and our leaders, Levites, and priests put their seals on it.

verses.kjv: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
verses.decoded: Now those who sealed were Nehemiah, the governor, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

verses.kjv: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
verses.decoded: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

verses.kjv: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,
verses.decoded: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

verses.kjv: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
verses.decoded: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

verses.kjv: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
verses.decoded: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

verses.kjv: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
verses.decoded: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

verses.kjv: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
verses.decoded: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

verses.kjv: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.
verses.decoded: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.

verses.kjv: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
verses.decoded: And the Levites: Jeshua, the son of Azaniah, Binnui from the sons of Henadad, and Kadmiel;

verses.kjv: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
verses.decoded: And their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

verses.kjv: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,
verses.decoded: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

verses.kjv: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
verses.decoded: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

verses.kjv: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
verses.decoded: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

verses.kjv: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
verses.decoded: The leaders of the people were Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, and Bani,

verses.kjv: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
verses.decoded: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.kjv: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
verses.decoded: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

verses.kjv: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
verses.decoded: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

verses.kjv: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
verses.decoded: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

verses.kjv: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
verses.decoded: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

verses.kjv: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
verses.decoded: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

verses.kjv: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,
verses.decoded: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

verses.kjv: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
verses.decoded: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

verses.kjv: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
verses.decoded: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

verses.kjv: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
verses.decoded: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

verses.kjv: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
verses.decoded: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

verses.kjv: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
verses.decoded: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

verses.kjv: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
verses.decoded: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
verses.decoded: And the rest of the people, including the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the Nethinims, and all who had separated themselves from the people of the lands to follow the law of God, along with their wives, their sons, and their daughters, each one having knowledge and understanding;

verses.kjv: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;
verses.decoded: They joined themselves closely to their fellow Israelites, their leaders, and agreed to a curse and an oath to follow God's law, which was given by Moses, the servant of God, and to obey and carry out all the commandments of the LORD our God, and His decisions and His laws;

verses.kjv: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:
verses.decoded: And that we would not give our daughters to the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

verses.kjv: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
verses.decoded: And if the people of the land bring goods or any food on the Sabbath day to sell, we will not buy it from them on the Sabbath or on the holy day; and we will observe the seventh year and cancel every debt.

verses.kjv: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
verses.decoded: We also made rules for ourselves to pay each year a third of a shekel for the work of the house of our God;

verses.kjv: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.decoded: For the showbread, and for the regular grain offering, and for the regular burnt offering, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, for the appointed festivals, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

verses.kjv: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law:
verses.decoded: We cast lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people to decide who would bring the wood offering into the house of our God, according to the ancestral homes, at the appointed times each year, to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law.

verses.kjv: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the Lord:
verses.decoded: And to bring the first produce of our land, and the first produce of all fruit from all trees, every year, to the house of the LORD:

verses.kjv: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
verses.decoded: Also the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who serve in the house of our God.

verses.kjv: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
verses.decoded: And that we should bring the first portion of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of every kind of tree, of wine and of oil, to the priests, to the storerooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our land to the Levites, so that the Levites may receive the tithes in all the towns where we farm.

verses.kjv: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
verses.decoded: The priest, a descendant of Aaron, will be with the Levites when the Levites collect the tithes. The Levites will bring a tenth of those tithes to the house of our God, into the storage rooms, into the treasury.

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel and the Levites will bring the offering of grain, new wine, and oil to the storerooms where the sanctuary vessels are kept, along with the priests who serve, the gatekeepers, and the singers. We will not abandon the house of our God.

verses.kjv: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
verses.decoded: The leaders of the people lived in Jerusalem; the rest of the people also cast lots to select one out of every ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine out of ten to live in the other towns.

verses.kjv: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: The people praised all the men who voluntarily offered to live in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.decoded: These are the leaders of the province who lived in Jerusalem, but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in their own property in their cities, including Israel, the priests, the Levites, the Nethinims, and the descendants of Solomon’s servants.

verses.kjv: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.decoded: And in Jerusalem lived some of the descendants of Judah and some of the descendants of Benjamin. Among the descendants of Judah: Athaiah, the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, from the descendants of Perez;

verses.kjv: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.decoded: And Maaseiah, the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

verses.kjv: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.decoded: All the descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight brave men.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.decoded: These are the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, who was the son of Joed, who was the son of Pedaiah, who was the son of Kolaiah, who was the son of Maaseiah, who was the son of Ithiel, who was the son of Jesaiah.

verses.kjv: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.decoded: After him were Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight in total.

verses.kjv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.decoded: Joel, the son of Zichri, was their leader, and Judah, the son of Senuah, was second in charge over the city.

verses.kjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.decoded: Among the priests: Jedaiah, the son of Joiarib, and Jachin.

verses.kjv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
verses.decoded: Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the leader of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
verses.decoded: And their brothers who did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty-two: and Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

verses.kjv: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.decoded: And his brothers, leaders of the families, two hundred forty-two: and Amashai, the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.kjv: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
verses.decoded: And their brothers, strong and brave men, were one hundred twenty-eight; and their leader was Zabdiel, the son of one of the important men.

verses.kjv: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.decoded: Also among the Levites: Shemaiah, son of Hashub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni;

verses.kjv: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.decoded: Shabbethai and Jozabad, who were leaders among the Levites, were responsible for managing the external affairs of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.decoded: And Mattaniah, the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the leader who began the thanksgiving in prayer; and Bakbukiah was second among his brothers, and Abda was the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.kjv: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.decoded: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred and eighty-four.

verses.kjv: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
verses.decoded: Also, the gatekeepers Akkub, Talmon, and their relatives who guarded the gates were one hundred seventy-two.

verses.kjv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.decoded: The rest of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, lived in all the cities of Judah, each one in the land he had inherited.

verses.kjv: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
verses.decoded: But the Nethinims lived in Ophel, and Ziha and Gispa were in charge of the Nethinims.

verses.kjv: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
verses.decoded: The supervisor of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi, the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Among the descendants of Asaph, the singers were responsible for the work of the house of God.

verses.kjv: For it was the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.decoded: Because the king commanded that a specific portion be set aside for the singers, to be given every day.

verses.kjv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.decoded: And Pethahiah, the son of Meshezabeel, from the descendants of Zerah, the son of Judah, was the king’s representative in all matters concerning the people.

verses.kjv: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
verses.decoded: And for the villages with their fields, some of the descendants of Judah lived in Kirjath-arba and its villages, and in Dibon and its villages, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,

verses.kjv: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
verses.decoded: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

verses.kjv: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages thereof,
verses.decoded: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages around them,

verses.kjv: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
verses.decoded: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages around them,

verses.kjv: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
verses.decoded: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

verses.kjv: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.decoded: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, at Lachish and its fields, at Azekah and its villages. And they lived from Beer-sheba to the valley of Hinnom.

verses.kjv: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-el, and in their villages,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Benjamin from Geba lived in Michmash, Aija, Bethel, and in their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.decoded: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.kjv: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.decoded: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.kjv: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.decoded: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.kjv: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.decoded: Lod and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

verses.kjv: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
verses.decoded: There were groups of Levites in Judah and in Benjamin.

verses.kjv: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
verses.decoded: These are the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

verses.kjv: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
verses.decoded: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.kjv: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
verses.decoded: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.kjv: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
verses.decoded: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

verses.kjv: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.decoded: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

verses.kjv: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
verses.decoded: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.kjv: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
verses.decoded: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and their fellow priests during the time of Jeshua.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
verses.decoded: Also the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was in charge of the thanksgiving, he and his brothers.

verses.kjv: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
verses.decoded: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brothers, were opposite them during the shifts.

verses.kjv: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
verses.decoded: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, Joiakim also became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

verses.kjv: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
verses.decoded: Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

verses.kjv: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.decoded: During the time of Joiakim, the leading priests were: from the family of Seraiah, Meraiah; from the family of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.kjv: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.decoded: From Ezra, Meshullam; from Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.kjv: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
verses.decoded: From Melicu, Jonathan; from Shebaniah, Joseph;

verses.kjv: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.decoded: From Harim, Adna; from Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.kjv: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.decoded: From Iddo, Zechariah; from Ginnethon, Meshullam;

verses.kjv: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.decoded: From Abijah, Zichri; from Miniamin, from Moadiah, Piltai;

verses.kjv: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.decoded: From Bilgah, Shammua; from Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.kjv: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.decoded: From Joiarib, Mattenai; from Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.kjv: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.decoded: From Sallai, Kallai; from Amok, Eber;

verses.kjv: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
verses.decoded: From Hilkiah, Hashabiah; from Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

verses.kjv: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.decoded: The Levites during the time of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua were recorded as leaders of the families; also the priests, up to the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.kjv: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Levi, the leaders of the families, were recorded in the book of records, up to the time of Johanan, the son of Eliashib.

verses.kjv: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
verses.decoded: The leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua, the son of Kadmiel, along with their fellow Levites opposite them, to praise and give thanks, following the command of David, the man of God, standing opposite each other in their divisions.

verses.kjv: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
verses.decoded: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers guarding the entrances of the gates.

verses.kjv: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
verses.decoded: These events happened during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and also during the time of Nehemiah the governor, and Ezra the priest, the scribe.

verses.kjv: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.decoded: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they gathered the Levites from all their places to bring them to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication with joy, including thanksgivings, singing, cymbals, psalteries, and harps.

verses.kjv: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
verses.decoded: The descendants of the singers gathered together, both from the flat areas surrounding Jerusalem and from the villages of Netophathi;

verses.kjv: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Also from the family of Gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, because the singers had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.decoded: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean, and they made the people, the gates, and the wall clean.

verses.kjv: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
verses.decoded: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up onto the wall and assigned two large groups of them who gave thanks, with one group going on the right side along the wall toward the Dung Gate:

verses.kjv: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
verses.decoded: And following them went Hoshaiah, along with half of the leaders of Judah,

verses.kjv: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.decoded: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

verses.kjv: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.decoded: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

verses.kjv: And certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
verses.decoded: And some of the priests' sons with trumpets; specifically, Zechariah, the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

verses.kjv: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
verses.decoded: And his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David, the man of God, and Ezra the scribe leading them.

verses.kjv: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.decoded: At the fountain gate, which was opposite them, they went up the stairs of the city of David, at the place where the wall rises, above the house of David, all the way to the water gate on the east side.

verses.kjv: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
verses.decoded: And the other group of those who were giving thanks went opposite them, and I followed them, along with half of the people on the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces all the way to the broad wall;

verses.kjv: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
verses.decoded: And from above the Ephraim Gate, and above the Old Gate, and above the Fish Gate, and the Tower of Hananeel, and the Tower of Meah, all the way to the Sheep Gate; and they stopped at the Prison Gate.

verses.kjv: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
verses.decoded: So the two groups of those who gave thanks stood in the house of God, along with me and half of the leaders with me.

verses.kjv: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.decoded: And the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah with trumpets;

verses.kjv: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.decoded: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loudly, led by their overseer Jezrahiah.

verses.kjv: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.decoded: On that same day, they offered large sacrifices and were very happy because God made them very joyful. The wives and children were happy too, so the happiness of Jerusalem could be heard from far away.

verses.kjv: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
verses.decoded: At that time, some were appointed to be in charge of the rooms for the treasures, the offerings, the firstfruits, and the tithes, to collect from the fields of the cities the portions required by the law for the priests and Levites, because Judah was glad for the priests and Levites who served.

verses.kjv: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.decoded: Both the singers and the gatekeepers kept the watch of their God, and the watch of the purification, according to the command of David and his son Solomon.

verses.kjv: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.decoded: During the time of David and Asaph long ago, there were leaders of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

verses.kjv: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
verses.decoded: All Israel during the time of Zerubbabel and during the time of Nehemiah gave the portions for the singers and the gatekeepers, each day his portion. They dedicated the holy things to the Levites, and the Levites dedicated them to the descendants of Aaron.

verses.kjv: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
verses.decoded: On that day, they read from the book of Moses in front of the people; and in it, they found written that the Ammonite and the Moabite should never enter the assembly of God.

verses.kjv: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.decoded: Because they did not welcome the children of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam to curse them, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
verses.decoded: After they heard the law, they separated all the foreigners from Israel.

verses.kjv: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:
verses.decoded: And earlier, Eliashib the priest, who was in charge of the storeroom of the house of our God, was friendly with Tobiah:

verses.kjv: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
verses.decoded: And he had prepared a large room for him, where previously they placed the grain offerings, the frankincense, the containers, and the tithes of grain, new wine, and oil, which were commanded to be given to the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the offerings of the priests.

verses.kjv: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
verses.decoded: But during all this time I was not in Jerusalem, because in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes, king of Babylon, I went to the king, and after some days I received permission from the king.

verses.kjv: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.decoded: I arrived in Jerusalem and learned about the wrong that Eliashib did for Tobiah by preparing a room for him in the courts of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.decoded: And it deeply upset me, so I threw out all of Tobiah's household belongings from the room.

verses.kjv: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
verses.decoded: Then I gave the order, and they cleaned the rooms; and I brought back the vessels of the house of God there, along with the grain offering and the incense.

verses.kjv: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
verses.decoded: I realized that the Levites had not been given their portions, because the Levites and the singers who performed the work had each gone to their own fields.

verses.kjv: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.decoded: Then I argued with the leaders and said, Why is the house of God abandoned? So I gathered them together and put them back in their proper place.

verses.kjv: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
verses.decoded: Then all the people of Judah brought the tenth part of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the storehouses.

verses.kjv: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
verses.decoded: I appointed treasurers over the treasuries: Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah of the Levites. Next to them was Hanan, the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah, because they were considered trustworthy, and their duty was to distribute to their fellow workers.

verses.kjv: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
verses.decoded: Remember me, O my God, about this, and do not erase the good things I have done for the house of my God and for its services.

verses.kjv: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
verses.decoded: During those days, I saw some people in Judah pressing grapes in winepresses on the Sabbath, bringing in bundles of grain, loading donkeys, as well as bringing wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of loads into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. I spoke out against them on the day they sold food.

verses.kjv: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: There were also men from Tyre living there, who brought fish and all kinds of goods, and sold them on the Sabbath to the people of Judah and in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
verses.decoded: Then I argued with the leaders of Judah and said to them, What wrong thing are you doing by disrespecting the Sabbath day?

verses.kjv: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
verses.decoded: Did not your ancestors do this, and did not our God bring all this disaster upon us and this city? Yet you are bringing even more anger on Israel by disrespecting the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the gates of Jerusalem started to get dark before the Sabbath, I ordered that the gates be closed and instructed that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I also stationed some of my servants at the gates so that no load would be brought in on the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.decoded: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods stayed outside Jerusalem once or twice.

verses.kjv: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
verses.decoded: Then I confronted them and said to them, Why are you staying around the wall? If you do this again, I will seize you. From that time on, they no longer came on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
verses.decoded: I instructed the Levites to purify themselves and to come and guard the gates to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me, O my God, about this too, and have mercy on me because of your great kindness.

verses.kjv: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:
verses.decoded: At that time, I also saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab:

verses.kjv: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.
verses.decoded: And their children spoke partly in the language of Ashdod, and could not speak in the language of the Jews, but spoke according to the language of each people.

verses.kjv: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
verses.decoded: And I argued with them, cursed them, struck some of them, pulled out their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, You must not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.

verses.kjv: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
verses.decoded: Did not Solomon, king of Israel, sin because of these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, who was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. However, even he was caused to sin by foreign women.

verses.kjv: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
verses.decoded: Should we listen to you and do all this great evil by disobeying our God by marrying foreign wives?

verses.kjv: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
verses.decoded: One of the sons of Joiada, who was the son of Eliashib the high priest, was married to the daughter of Sanballat the Horonite; so I sent him away from me.

verses.kjv: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
verses.decoded: Remember them, O my God, because they have dishonored the priesthood, and the agreement of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

verses.kjv: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;
verses.decoded: In this way, I purified them from all foreigners and assigned the responsibilities to the priests and the Levites, each one in his own task;

verses.kjv: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good. THE
verses.decoded: And for the wood offering, at the appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
